summary: Popovers and dialogs come with default styles: the browser centers a popover and draws a border. You can restyle them like any element, and ::backdrop styles the layer behind them.
notes: [popover] is an attribute selector that matches any element with the popover attribute, open or closed.
::backdrop dims the page behind an open popover. Click the button in the preview to see it. It also appears behind a dialog opened with showModal().
dialog { position: static; } keeps this non-modal dialog in the normal flow, below the button.
pitfall: Setting display: block on [popover]. That overrides the browser's display: none for closed popovers, so the popover is always visible.
